# Trust must cost something

Ivo once taught Mara every bolt in the tower, then blamed her for the wreck. Access produces wary cooperation. A direct question can elicit an admission and a shared repair; leaving him behind saves lives but leaves their estrangement intact. These named conditions are not numeric affection scores.
